title: Day 2 of making my first game with no dev experience. Thank you for the tips and feedback!
author: Gambo7592
selftext: Just wanted to share some progress, im using AI to build a little chill and cozy game. just trying to dial in on the animations, mechanics and feel of the player models. Having a lot of fun learning and creating as I go. Thanks again to everyone who commented and gave me helpful tips on my last post. I appreciate it! 😊

comments.author: Gambo7592
comments.body: I use claude specifically Opus 4.6 to write prompts for gemini to create 2D models. Then i use Meshy AI to turn the 2D models into the 3D assets, have claude put them into blender to remove the unnecessary polygons and triangles then into unity.
